correctness.rationale: For Gibbs weights 1,b,c with J in {0,1,2}, exact moment algebra yields variance P/Z^2 with P=b+4c+bc and third cumulant Q/Z^3 where Q=(c-1)(b^2-bc-b-8c). Independent symbolic reduction reproduced both identities, and for sampled M≥256 confirmed derivative signs +,-,+,- at x=L,L+1,3L/2,2L+1. The proof bounds Q/(PZ)>1/3 at the negative checkpoints uniformly for M≥256; positive checkpoints use Q≤0. Continuity and analyticity force two strict local maxima separated by a minimum. Near hot/cold scales two adjacent levels dominate, giving x=L+4/L+O(L^-2) and 2L+2/L+O(L^-2), heights L²/4 and L². The midpoint is exactly 9L²/[2(sqrt M+2)]. Domain is integer M≥256 and strictly positive temperatures; at least two maxima, not an assertion of exactly two or of phase transitions.
